question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

void update(int n, int *p) {
    if (n <= 0)
        return;

    *p = *p + n;

    update(n - 2, p);

    *p = *p + n;
}

int main() {
    int x = 1;

    update(5, &x);

    printf("%d", x);

    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int fun(int n) {
    int x = n;

    if (n <= 0)
        return 0;

    x = x + 2;

    return x + fun(n - 2);
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", fun(5));
    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int fun(int n) {
    if (n <= 1)
        return n + 1;

    if (n % 2 == 0)
        return fun(n - 1) + fun(n - 2);

    return fun(n - 2) + n;
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", fun(5));
    return 0;
}

question.text:
How many times is $\texttt{fun()}$ called when the following code is executed? (Count the first call also).

#include <stdio.h>

int fun(int n) {
    if (n <= 1)
        return 1;

    return fun(n - 1) + fun(n - 2);
}

int main() {
    fun(4);
    return 0;
}
